summary: Phase N — Growth engine tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 11/11 PASS at /app/backend/tests/test_phase_n.py. Frontend Playwright 100% PASS for all required testids on /app/referrals (investor), /app/admin/growth (admin), public landing (?ref=AF-INV001&utm_source=tiktok), and /signup (referral_code prefilled from localStorage). Full referral E2E loop validated: new signup with referral_code=AF-INV001 → KYC upgrade → wallet fund → invest → ₦2,000 credited to BOTH the referee and referrer wallets (verified via ledger 'referral_bonus' entries + balance delta), invited_count and activated_count incremented on referrer's /referrals/stats, and second invest by same referee did NOT trigger a duplicate bonus (idempotent via invest_referral_bonus_given flag). Public referral link uses preview origin (https://agri-fintech-ng.preview.emergentagent.com/signup?role=investor&ref=AF-INV001) — no internal cluster hostname leak. Funnel percentages capped at 100%. Non-admin gets 403 on /api/stats/platform-metrics. Regression: InvestorPortfolio, MyInvestments, Opportunities pages all load with no console/page errors.

minor.issue: Funnel can show denominator=0 with numerator>0 when invests in window correspond to deposits that occurred BEFORE the window. Example seen at days=90: depositor_count=0, investor_count=4, so funnel renders '4/0 depositors → 100%' (capped correctly numerically, but the raw counts display is mathematically misleading). Consider also counting depositors as 'all-time depositors among users who invested in window' OR clarifying the textual ratio in the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Displays '4 / 0 depositors' and '4 / 0 signups' on 90d range when depositor/signup counts are 0 but invest count is 4 — confusing for admin. Either coalesce to N/A when denominator==0 or recompute denominator as base population (all-time).

action_items: (LOW) Fix AdminGrowth funnel display when denominator is 0 — show '—' or recompute denominator over the total population so 'n/d' is never numerator>denominator. Currently the cap-at-100% in backend is correct, but the human-readable counts (e.g. '4/0 depositors') look broken.

(NICE-TO-HAVE) Consider counting `depositor_count` as 'distinct users with kind=fund anywhere who ALSO invested in window' instead of strict-window deposits — would more honestly reflect deposit→invest conversion.

rca of the issue: AdminGrowth '4/0 depositors' RCA: phase_n.platform_metrics filters depositors via db.ledger.distinct(user_id, {kind:'fund', created_at>=since}). The seed investor's ₦2M deposit happens at server startup (created_at = boot time). On a 90d window starting today, if the boot-time entry is older than 90 days OR the seed runs only once at original boot, that user's deposit is excluded — yet their pre-existing investments still appear in db.investments within window. Result: investors_active=4, depositors=0, ratio displays '4/0' before the cap kicks in. Mitigation: either show '—' when denominator==0, or change depositor_count to include any user with kind=fund all-time who also invested in window.
